description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 02/2023, Excise Duty on Liquor
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory matters under the Excise Ordinance, specifically setting new excise duty rates on various types of liquor. It contains a legal notification (Excise Notification No. 02/2023) that establishes regulatory requirements and compliance rules for liquor manufacturers. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government structure or personnel matters.
